packageRules.description: Non-major, non-0.x dependencies: grouped and auto-merged. Safe only because typecheck/lint/test/migration-test/gitleaks/license-gate/trivy/compose-hardening are all blocking on the same PR (D14).
Major bumps and anything still at 0.x always need a human.
0.x packages have no SemVer guarantee — never auto-merge, regardless of update type.
Docker base images: digest-pinned everywhere already (D13); Renovate proposes the digest bump, never a floating tag.
GitHub Actions: same digest-pinning policy as Docker images — every action in .github/workflows/*.yml is pinned to a commit SHA, never a tag (06 §5.1).
Node is pinned to the 26.x line (D1) until a deliberate LTS-line decision.
Postgres major-version bumps are a dump/restore project, not a Renovate PR (D2).
The pnpm version pinned in package.json's packageManager field and CI's `npm install --global pnpm@...` line move together, deliberately, not on Renovate's schedule.
